Ahmedabad's industrial belt — spanning GIDC Vatva, Naroda, Odhav, and the fast-expanding Sanand corridor — generates constant demand for portable site offices, security guard rooms, and temporary worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and despatches them to Ahmedabad and surrounding GIDC zones in 3 to 5 days. If you are looking for a porta cabin in Ahmedabad for a construction project, plant gate, or industrial site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a quotation.

SAMAN security and site-office porta cabins delivered to GIDC Vatva, Naroda, and Sanand in 3–5 days.

Why Ahmedabad Buyers Choose SAMAN

Most porta cabin listings buyers see in Ahmedabad are from marketplace aggregator pages — TradeIndia and IndiaMART category listings that mix dozens of different suppliers without specifying frame grade, panel thickness, or any real build detail. Buyers end up calling multiple unknown vendors to compare.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. When you call us, you speak directly to the team that runs our porta cabin manufacturing. There is no middleman, no reseller margin, and no ambiguity about what you are getting:

  • Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, not unnamed "mild steel"
  • Panel: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels or cement-board, your choice
  • Roof: Colour-coated GI sheet with measured drainage slope
  • Electrical: MCB board, ELCB, pre-wired power points — not add-on extras

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications, along with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Buying direct from the manufacturer also means a clean paper trail — a GST tax invoice in your company's name, raised against the exact cabin built and dispatched to your specification, not a resold unit of unknown origin handled through a chain of intermediaries.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000. Transit: 3–5 days from Greater Noida to Ahmedabad. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Ahmedabad's Industrial Zones and Porta Cabin Demand

Ahmedabad and the Greater Ahmedabad region host several industrial clusters where porta cabin demand is concentrated and recurring:

GIDC Vatva (PIN 382445): One of Gujarat's largest chemical and engineering GIDC estates. Security cabins at plant gate entries and portable QC rooms near production floors are the primary requirement. The chemical environment here makes powder-coated frames and cement-board panels the preferred specification over bare-metal options.

Compact porta cabins for gate security and supervisor rooms at Ahmedabad GIDC plants.

Naroda GIDC (PIN 382330): Textile, packaging, and light engineering units in Naroda need security posts and small portable offices at plot entries. Single-room and double-room cabins are the most common format.

Odhav Industrial Estate (PIN 382415): Mixed manufacturing. Auto-component firms and engineering workshops here use porta cabins as tool stores, supervisor offices, and guest/visitor rooms at factory gates.

Sanand Industrial Zone (PIN 382110): Tata Motors' Sanand plant and its large tier-1 supplier ecosystem have generated significant new construction activity. Greenfield plant construction requires multi-room contractor offices and labour accommodation blocks — typically 10 to 30 cabins per large project.

Changodar Industrial Area (PIN 382213): Logistics parks, cold chains, and warehousing hubs near Changodar frequently need portable site offices and security guard rooms during construction and while facilities are being commissioned.

SAMAN despatches from Greater Noida via NH-48. Ahmedabad is 3–5 transit days on a direct flatbed run. We run the same western-India despatch lane for our porta cabin in Mumbai and porta cabin in Pune customers, and the Greater Noida plant also anchors our North India porta cabin supply.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, and anchor-bolted to RCC plinth. Handles Ahmedabad's hot, dry summers and occasional strong winds without distortion.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard. Cement-board panels recommended for chemical-adjacent environments (Vatva GIDC) where PUF can be sensitive to fume exposure over long durations.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet. Optional turbo ventilators — strongly recommended for Ahmedabad's peak summer temperatures (May–June can exceed 42°C in industrial sites with no shade).

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial laminate.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows. Fixed glazing on request. All windows factory-fitted — no site cutting.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room modular block, with attached toilet, with pantry.

Applications in Ahmedabad

Porta cabins from SAMAN are used across Ahmedabad's industrial and construction landscape for:

  • Plant gate security rooms: Single-room guard cabins at GIDC plot entries in Vatva, Naroda, and Odhav — a high-volume recurring order type from Ahmedabad's manufacturing sector.
  • Contractor site offices: Multi-room office blocks at greenfield plant construction in Sanand, road expansion projects on SH-17, and metro rail Phase 2 extension sites.
  • Labour colony accommodation: Worker accommodation blocks at large construction projects in Sanand and Changodar where outstation labour needs on-site housing.
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms: Clean, lockable rooms adjacent to production lines in chemical and auto-component plants in Vatva and Odhav.
  • Real-estate sales offices: Temporary cabin sales offices at project launch sites in emerging residential corridors of SG Highway and SP Ring Road.

Porta cabins with canopy and custom colour for real-estate sales offices on SG Highway and SP Ring Road projects.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built to your specification:

  • Custom dimensions — length, width, and room count per your floor plan
  • Colour selection from standard RAL palette
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + dedicated electrical point) — strongly recommended for Ahmedabad's summer conditions
  • Additional turbo ventilators for high-temperature industrial environments
  • Internal partition walls for dividing a single module into two spaces
  • Extra door and window units
  • Plumbing provision for attached toilet or pantry
  • Two-storey stacking where structural load calculations confirm safety

Tell us your site conditions, required size, and use case. We will confirm specifications and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Ahmedabad — What You Need to Know

The price of a porta cabin in Ahmedabad is not a fixed catalogue number. It depends on:

  1. Size: An 8×10 ft single-room cabin is the lowest cost. A 10×40 ft four-room block is substantially more. Specify your exact requirement.
  2. Panel type: PUF sandwich panel vs cement-board. Cement board costs slightly more but is the right choice for chemical-zone sites.
  3. Fit-out level: A bare structural shell costs less than a fully fitted cabin with electrical, flooring, paint, and AC provision.
  4. AC and heat management: Ahmedabad's summer means most industrial buyers add AC provisions at order stage — factor this in upfront.
  5. Quantity: Multi-cabin orders (5 or more units) attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate price for porta cabin in Ahmedabad based on your site and specification, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Ahmedabad

We despatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308). Cabins travel to Ahmedabad via NH-48 on flatbed trucks. Standard transit: 3–5 days.

On delivery, the cabin is placed on your pre-cast RCC plinth. Anchor bolts are secured, panel joints are checked, and the MCB board is connected. A single-room cabin is ready to use within hours of arrival. A multi-room block typically takes one day.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Multiple units in one truck — confirm consolidated rate at order stage.

Before delivery, prepare a level base — an RCC plinth, a concrete pad, or firm compacted ground — sized slightly larger than the cabin footprint, with a clear approach for the flatbed trailer to reach the unloading point. At congested GIDC plots, tell us the gate width and any height restriction at order stage so we can plan the trailer and, where needed, a crane or hydra for placement. A 230 V power point near the site lets our team energise the MCB board for an on-the-spot function check before they leave.

We do not have an Ahmedabad showroom or warehouse. Your cabin is manufactured to order at our Greater Noida factory and delivered factory-direct to your GIDC or construction site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Ahmedabad

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to GIDC Vatva, Naroda, and Sanand?

Yes. We deliver across Ahmedabad's industrial zones — GIDC Vatva, Naroda, Odhav, Changodar, and Sanand — and to construction sites anywhere in the Greater Ahmedabad area. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

What type of panel is recommended for Ahmedabad's chemical GIDC zones?

For GIDC Vatva and other chemical-adjacent environments, cement-board sandwich panels are recommended over standard PUF panels. Cement board is less sensitive to chemical fumes over extended use. The MS frame specification is identical in both cases — IS 2062 Grade A, zinc-phosphate primed.

How do SAMAN porta cabins handle Ahmedabad's extreme summer heat?

The colour-coated GI roof reflects significant solar heat. We recommend adding a turbo ventilator and an internal false ceiling on all Ahmedabad orders. For 24-hour use, an AC provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + dedicated power point) is strongly advised. Standard cabins with these additions perform well even at 42°C+ ambient temperatures.

What is the delivery time for a porta cabin to Ahmedabad?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at the time of enquiry. Standard in-stock sizes typically move faster.

Can I get a porta cabin for transport from factory to Ahmedabad and use it for only 6 months?

SAMAN sells porta cabins — we do not operate a rental fleet. For short-duration projects, buying a cabin and reselling or redeploying it after the project often costs less than rental when you factor in the total duration. Call us and we can walk you through the numbers for your specific timeline.

Get a Porta Cabin Quote for Ahmedabad

To get a porta cabin in Ahmedabad delivered to your GIDC plot, construction site, or project yard, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. You can also send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with full specifications, delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.
